ticker: Infosys cuts forecast amid AI shift
RBI warns of AI cyber risks

articles.headline: Infosys Cuts Revenue Forecast on North American AI Slowdown
articles.brief: Infosys has lowered its annual revenue growth guidance following a deeper-than-expected slowdown in North America, as corporate spending shifts aggressively toward artificial intelligence technologies, impacting traditional IT service demand.

articles.headline: Mark Zuckerberg Says AI Agents Costly and May Not Stay Free
articles.brief: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg stated that while adoption of the Muse chatbot has surpassed 10 million users, the immense computational expenses of artificial intelligence mean services may eventually require paid subscription models.

articles.headline: Ambani's Jio Secures Record $77 Billion in Indian IPO Bids
articles.brief: Reliance Industries' telecom arm Jio has recorded the most subscribed initial public offering in Indian corporate history, pulling in an unprecedented $77 billion in investor bids from global and domestic institutions.

articles.headline: American Express Lifts Profit Outlook and Announces 5% Workforce Cuts
articles.brief: American Express has raised its long-term profit forecast for 2026 while simultaneously announcing plans to reduce its global workforce by 5 percent to streamline operations and adapt to changing macroeconomic pressures.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Rules Voters Can Prosecute Electoral Candidates for Concealing Data
articles.brief: In a landmark judgment, the Supreme Court of India held that individual voters possess the legal standing to directly prosecute political candidates who conceal essential information in their election affidavits.

articles.headline: Congress Submits Seat-Sharing Proposal to Samajwadi Party for UP Polls
articles.brief: The Congress party has handed over its initial candidate shortlist to the Samajwadi Party, demanding between 175 and 200 assembly seats as negotiations intensify ahead of the upcoming Uttar Pradesh state elections.

articles.headline: Fast-Fashion Giant Shein Agrees to $100 Million US FTC Settlement
articles.brief: Online retail giant Shein has agreed to a $100 million financial settlement to resolve an ongoing antitrust and consumer protection probe conducted by the United States Federal Trade Commission.

articles.headline: Tata Motors Returns to Profitability in Q2 Driven by Commercial Vehicles
articles.brief: Tata Motors reported a net profit of ₹1,254 crore for the second quarter, bolstered by a 42 percent surge in domestic commercial vehicle sales despite expectations of moderate growth moving forward.

articles.headline: India Concludes Asian Para Games Campaign with 65 Medals
articles.brief: Indian athletes wrapped up their impressive run at the Asian Para Games, finishing the multi-sport international competition with a total haul of 65 medals across various disciplines.

articles.headline: Pratika Rawal and Shree Charani Lead India to Win Over Zimbabwe
articles.brief: Opener Pratika Rawal scored an unbeaten century and bowler Shree Charani claimed four wickets to guide the Indian women's cricket team to a convincing nine-wicket victory over Zimbabwe in the opening ODI.

articles.headline: J.P. Morgan Projects $22 Billion GLP-1 Market in Emerging Economies
articles.brief: A new report from J.P. Morgan estimates that expanding distribution of GLP-1 weight-loss medications across China, India, and Brazil could unlock a massive $22 billion commercial healthcare market by the year 2035.

articles.headline: IIT Bombay Scholar Develops Low-Cost Indoor Air Purifier
articles.brief: An academic scholar at IIT Bombay has engineered an affordable air purification prototype starting at ₹2,000, utilizing natural plant fibers and microbes to reduce local particulate air pollution index scores significantly.

articles.headline: US Midterm Elections Pose Crucial Test for Congressional Control
articles.brief: With all House seats and key Senate positions up for election on November 3, the upcoming United States midterms serve as a decisive referendum on the legislative agenda of the current presidential administration.

articles.headline: White House Announces Melania Trump Brokerage of Local Ceasefire
articles.brief: The White House has confirmed that diplomatic interventions led by Melania Trump successfully secured a temporary one-city ceasefire in the contested Ukrainian municipality of Oleshky amidst ongoing regional hostilities.

articles.headline: RBI Governor Warns Financial Institutions of Emerging AI Cyber Threats
articles.brief: Reserve Bank of India Governor has cautioned commercial lenders about sophisticated, artificial intelligence-driven cyber security risks, urging banking institutions to immediately upgrade infrastructural defenses.
